name: DealGate
status: Refined visual system. Supersedes v2.0 tokens; policy values unchanged.
direction: Plum executive surface, one violet accent, lime reserved for the single hero action inside plum. Editorial serif for titles only; Inter for everything else.
colorRules: primary is the only accent. It is used for the main button, selected navigation, links, the in-progress state and focus rings.
lime appears only on the single hero action inside the plum banner. Never on a normal page.
plum is the executive banner and the toast/tooltip surface. It is not a page or card background.
success, warning and danger are semantic. They are never used decoratively or as chart series.
Chart series are chartSeries1 and chartSeries2 only, assigned in fixed order. A floor or target is a text-colored line, not a third color.
Every status chip carries a dot and a word. Color alone never encodes state.

contrast.method: WCAG 2.x relative luminance, computed on 19 Sep 2026 for the pairs below
contrast.note: border and borderStrong are decorative and below 3:1 by design; inputBorder is the control boundary. Chart series pairs pass CVD separation in both themes (validated).

display.use: Executive banner headline and page H1 only

typography.numerals: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every money, percentage, count and date column

elevation.rule: Borders separate; shadows float. Cards and panels use a 1px border and no shadow. Only menus, tooltips and dialogs get shadowOverlay.
elevation.stripe: A 3px left stripe in danger, warning or primary marks a blocked, at-risk or in-progress card. Nothing else gets a stripe.

floorBar.fill: success when at or above floor, danger below

gateSteps.note: hold is danger-tinted and reads 'Will trigger' before the gate is reached

executiveBanner.motif: two thin plumLine circles, top right, never overlapping text
executiveBanner.metrics: plumRaised tiles, 26px value, alert values in lime

marginPolicy.mixedRule: Evaluate each applicable geography independently; combined GM is informational
marginPolicy.exceptionAuthority: CEO; additional to Delivery, HR, Finance and Legal review
marginPolicy.precision: Decimal arithmetic; full precision for thresholds; rounding only for display
